decisions.reason: Its continued standalone presentation across 2023 and 2024, close fit with the firm's compliance-focused hosting offer, and modest resource demands suggest results are at least near aspiration and worth retaining.

As a homepage-featured flagship in both years that directly advances the firm's stated platform direction, it is highly likely to be judged strategically important and above the threshold for continuation.

Because it stayed on its own page for two years and is tightly linked to the core managed hosting business, management would likely see it as a satisfactory extension unless clearer evidence of shortfall appears.

Although its lower visibility and very recent launch make performance more uncertain, its strong fit with the firm's security and support capabilities plus likely organizational slack favor giving it more time on the market.
